comments.body:
## Cold review: #838 (tickets #1398 and #1406), head f23960faf

Read both tickets and the coordinator's proposals, the owner's notes and the paused-and-lead-tile screenshot, the wsp-review and wsp-design skills, and every changed file. Compared the 34 screenshots in both themes against the tiles and the mockup. Ran the touched tests plus parity, skill and contract at two workers.

### What I checked

- **Done is one row in the one status table.** `components/status/kinds/done.ts`, registered in `kinds/index.ts` between Failed and Resting; circle-check, `--status-done`, weight 500. The tile, the THREADS list and the palette all read it through `threadStatusOf`. Screenshots `tiles-*-1440` show it on "Dark mode contrast pass" in both themes.
- **Read and settled live on the host.** `ThreadRecord.readAt` and `settledAt` in the workspace's session document, stamped on every row by `sessions.list`, two new ops in DEVICE_OPS and not THREAD_OPS, `thread.marked` rereads the rows in every window. `wsp threads` reads Done off the same stamp in its existing STATE column; the `threads` tool answers both stamps; the skill row moved with it. Parity, skill and contract: 57 of 57.
- **The pause rule.** `tiles-paused-done-*`: the tile on the napping Solari fork says 3h and nothing else; the open thread's rule line says Paused with Wake beside it. The sidebar test pins that no Paused, Stopped, Unreachable, Waking or Failed word and no warning tone reaches the tile.
- **Two quiet hours after a read, never by time while unread.** `isThreadSettled` in `Sidebar.logic.ts`: counted from the later of last activity and the read stamp, a Done nobody opened or a Failed nobody looked at stays out, a hand settle folds at once, and any start or end after the settle brings the tree back. Tests in `threadTree.test.ts` and `WorkspaceSidebar.test.tsx` cover each branch.
- **The three actions.** Settle on a live root's menu taking the whole tree and held while a thread in it works; `mod+shift+e` on the open thread (no collision in `keybindingDefaults.ts`); Settle all read on the Settled row's own menu. All three tested.
- **The lead tile bug.** `before/tiles-scrolled-dark-1440.png` reproduces the owner's shot exactly: the 24px scroll fade ate row one and dimmed the title. Removing `scrollFade` from `SidebarContent` fixes it; the mockup's list has no fade.
- **Red first.** I reverted `components/ui/sidebar.tsx` to origin/main and ran `WorkspaceSidebar.test.tsx`: the hard-edge test went red alone (17 of 18), and green again restored. The rest I take from the report's 29 red cases.
- **AA contrast.** `--status-done` on the sidebar: 13.8:1 dark (#5ee9b5 on #000), 5.14:1 light (#007a55 on #fafafa), 4.88:1 on the light selected fill. All pass AA.
- **Design skill.** The Done row was already in the table; the branch adds the pause rule, a Settled fold section and a dated don't, and puts `done` in the mockup's STATUS table with t4 showing it.

### Tests

Touched files plus parity, skill and contract, `--minWorkers=1 --maxWorkers=2`: 812 of 813 on first run. The one failure, `contract.test.ts` "the tool server answers through the forwarder", was a stale `packages/host/dist` in my checkout (`bin.js` from 23 Sep); after `pnpm -r build` of the packages, contract, parity and skill pass 57 of 57. CI on the PR is green on all five jobs.

### Findings

**BLOCKERS (0)**

**SHOULD-FIX (1)**

1. `apps/web/src/sidebar/ThreadTile.tsx:128` and `tiles-settled-open-{dark,light}-1440.png`: a settled thread still wears its toned status. "Release notes for 0.9" sits inside the Settled fold with a red circle-alert Failed. The design skill's status table says a Settled row shows "Merged or Closed as text, else the age, muted", and the mockup draws every settled tile as idle with plain text (`tile(t, { word })`, `index.html:36`). The fold is where things go once a person has looked and moved on; a red word there is the alarm the owner's ruling removes. Decision 4 in the report names it ("Failed stays Failed"), so this is a ruling for the coordinator rather than an unreported deviation: either the fold's tiles read the age in the muted ink, as the table says, or the table's Settled row changes. Law: the approved mock is law for layout and feel; one loud thing per screen.

**NITS (3)**

1. `apps/web/src/components/chat/ChatView.tsx:275`: the Wake button inherits the rule line's 11px mono (`TimelineRuleLine` sets `font-mono text-[11px]`), and `Button` sets no family. The skill's buttons are 13px, weight 500, sans. Visible in `tiles-paused-done-*`. A `font-sans` on the button, or the xs keycap the skill describes, fixes it. Law: the type table.
2. `apps/web/src/sidebar/Sidebar.logic.ts:618`: a thread left open in the centre folds into Settled two hours after its read stamp, while it is on screen, because `useReadStamp` only moves the stamp while the thread is unread. Under the old 24h rule nobody reached this; at two hours a long review session will. Exempting the selected thread from the time fold, or restamping on an interval while shown, would close it.
3. `packages/protocol/src/index.ts:5419`: `sessions.read` and `sessions.settle` are ops only a window calls. A person who works from the command line alone never moves a stamp, so every finished thread reads Done in `wsp threads` until a window opens it. The parity test covers verbs and tools, so no law is broken, but AGENTS.md's "every capability in all three or in none" wants a ruling on whether `wsp threads settle` (and a read stamp from `wsp thread read`) belongs in a follow-up.

### Open ruling the report asks for

Decision 1: a turn cut by the machine pausing still reads Failed (`settleCut` in the runtime marks a turn with no reply `failed`). That is the likely cause of the Failed on "Build #1385" in the owner's screenshot, and the ruling reads "only a turn that failed reads Failed". Whether a pause cut is a failure needs the coordinator's word on the ticket; the builder has scoped the change (two tests pin "failed" today).

### What the diff did well

The stamps live on the thread's record, not its rows, so they survive the 200-row cap and a restart, and the `readsSince` floor keeps an upgrade from marking every old thread Done. The two ops sit in DEVICE_OPS so an agent cannot mark a person's thread read. Done is one registry row and nothing switches on it outside the kinds. The lead tile bug was reproduced before it was fixed, with the before shot kept. The merge commit names each resolution. The fixture clock rounding that made a shot flake by the minute was found and fixed rather than rerun.

**BLOCKERS (0) / SHOULD-FIX (1) / NITS (3)**

**MERGE-AFTER-FIXES**: the settled fold's Failed (or a ruling that keeps it), then merge.
Landed on main as b2f6cbd5c by squash. Ticket: https://github.com/Zingzy/wsp-map/issues/1398

commits.messageBody:
A finished turn nobody had opened looked the same as one that was read,
and a thread only left the list after 24 hours. The host now keeps a read
and a settled stamp per thread, so every window and wsp threads agree on
Done. A read thread settles after 2 hours quiet, Settle takes a tree by
hand, and new activity brings it back. The sidebar list drops its scroll
fade, which made a tile part way under the head look broken.
commits.messageHeadline: feat: a finished thread reads Done until seen, and threads settle

commits.messageBody:
Main moved while this branch was built; both sides kept.
protocol/index.ts: the export lines take threadUnread and placeSpendLimit.
runtime.ts: the protocol import takes main's spend cap names and threadKeyOf.
plan.test.mjs: the fixture and narrowed lists take main's image-built and
settings surfaces and this branch's tiles-scrolled and tiles-paused-done.

The design judge found the fold still wore a red Failed. Tiles in the
fold now read their age muted, a Failed never folds by time, and the
thread open in the centre stays on the list while it is read. wsp thread
read stamps the thread read so the command line and windows agree.
commits.messageHeadline: fix: settled tiles rest muted, and thread read marks the thread read

commits.messageBody:
Main moved again; both sides kept.
plan.mjs: the step grammar takes main's focus step and this branch's
scroll step, in one chain, and the index words name both.
plan.test.mjs: the narrowed list takes main's panel-launcher-mac and this
branch's tiles-scrolled and tiles-paused-done.

No file conflicted: git merged every file on its own and no hunk of
either side touched the other's lines.
commits.messageHeadline: merge origin/main into ticket/1398-done-and-settle before the gate
